_comment: Outbound rules per product. Everything defaults to blocked. A human must fill in sender identity, opt-out mechanism and a Legitimate Interests Assessment (LIA) before ANY draft can become eligible. This is not legal advice — check current ICO guidance on PECR and UK GDPR.

masjidone.note: Most masājid are unincorporated associations or charitable trusts = INDIVIDUAL subscribers under PECR → no unsolicited email. Only CIOs / charitable companies (corporate subscribers) can be emailed, and only with an LIA if the address names a person.

domi.note: Target limited companies running home-visit services. Many domiciliary practitioners are sole traders = individual subscribers → blocked.

booked-in.note: Audience is solo beauty professionals — overwhelmingly sole traders (individual subscribers). Organic social only. Also not provisioned for live sign-ups.

tidemark.note: Consumer app. No outbound prospecting; organic and App Store only.

bolton-vouched.note: Two-sided local directory. Residents are consumers and tradespeople are overwhelmingly sole traders, so both are INDIVIDUAL subscribers under PECR: no unsolicited email or texts. Traders join via personal consent links sent by the admin (a relationship, not automated marketing). Organic social and local community channels only.
